authority: AI-assisted engineering source review; not human gold. Exact quotes validated; interpretations remain reviewable.

findings.wording: غارات إسرائيلية تستهدف جنوب لبنان وتحذيرات من هجمات إضافية
findings.quote: سنشنّ غارات جوية على الجبهة اللبنانية خلال الساعات المقبلة
findings.explanation: A separate regional-council prospective announcement is combined with the earlier Baraachit occurrence. V7 retains two separate items.

findings.wording: about 20% of Anthropic shares are now dedicated
findings.quote: roughly 20% of Anthropic shares will be dedicated to the public good
findings.explanation: Present completed dedication replaces future dedication. V4 verifier approved. V7 English uses future plus approval condition.

findings.wording: سيحصل مبدئياً على 5% من أسهم الشركة
findings.quote: Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today
findings.explanation: The whole fund item omits stockholder approval, a condition on its central 5% commitment. The verifier approved it.

findings.wording: مع إمكانية إضافة 2% إضافية لكل زيادة بنسبة 50%
findings.quote: with an additional 2% added at the board’s discretion for every 50% increase
findings.explanation: The Arabic retains possibility, not an automatic escalator, but omits who decides. Board identity may be optional in a concise account; do not count this as a confirmed factual error or require the optional escalator. Review separately from the definite missing stockholder-approval condition.

findings.wording: ولا يمكن لـ Anthropic منع النشر إلا في حالات محددة
findings.quote: Anthropic can’t veto publication, but we can require them to redact information
findings.explanation: Arabic permits exceptions to a publication veto; the source permits redactions, not vetoing publication. V4 Arabic describes redactions. V7 verifier approved.

findings.wording: سيُخصص نحو 20% من أسهم Anthropic للمنفعة العامة حتى الآن
findings.quote: roughly 20% of Anthropic shares will be dedicated to the public good
findings.explanation: Future سيخصص with حتى الآن is unnatural and temporally confusing. Not counted as a separate confirmed completed-transfer assertion.

findings.quote: Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today
findings.explanation: The body retains approval, but a flat headline can overstate it. Since commitment is not necessarily completed transfer, treat this as unresolved rather than automatically scoring a false completion.

findings.wording: لم تؤكد مصادر من أنثروبيك إنهاء الشراكة بالكامل
findings.quote: One person familiar, who asked not to be named, said the partnership was still in place.
findings.explanation: An insider familiar with the partnership affirming continuation becomes sources from Anthropic not confirming termination. Source does not identify them as Anthropic sources.
